doc.title: Norman Simmons interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 27, 2007 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Joe Williams in Club DeLisa and the Buffalo false start
summary: He recalls Joe singing Pagliacci in a show, then a first gig with Joe in Buffalo while with Carmen McRae, which went badly.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Joe Williams: the singer with Basie

blocks.x: I was interested in, you said one of the first times you saw Joe Williams he was dressed in a clown outfit.

Singing Pagliacci in the Club DeLisa and doing a show. And that’s how broad the shows were, the kind of shows they presented. They really, it wasn’t just about jumping up and down, I mean there was a format to what they were doing. Very organized.

Did you have a — I think I’m trying to remember where I read this — that you had sort of a false start as working as Joe’s accompanist and musical director? Did — it almost happened but the guys you were playing with weren’t —
